name: method-figure-loop
title_zh: 论文方法图先画关系再定长相
tagline_zh: 画论文方法图总在排版上耗掉半天？它把关系放第一，自动生成可回放的分步 SVG。
tagline_en: Tired of tweaking layout for hours? It builds method figures from relationships, exports replayable SVG, and has.
desc_en: ALIGN for paper figures — draw a method-overview figure as an executable p5.js program that replays its own construction in named stages, exports SVG, and improves through pixel-only cross-model review whose gate is 'explain the method back from the figure alone, and is it worth looking at'. The method sets the relationships the figure must show, the chosen visual identity sets how its marks look,
why_zh: 机制核心是像素级跨模型评审：图生成后，另一模型只看图复述方法，门禁是“值不值得看”。
why_en: Core: pixel-only cross-model review—another model explains the method from the figure alone, gating on clarity and worth. Forces.
limit_zh: 只认 p5.js 可表达的关系图，输出到 SVG 为止；需要本地 Node 环境跑评审循环，且评审模型得支持视觉输入。
limit_en: Only p5.js-renderable relationship diagrams, output ends at SVG. Needs local Node for review loop; reviewer model must accept images. No photos, 3D.
title_en: Method figures as executable p5.js with cross-model review
